0592d1ebecd554: An interactive course platform accompanied by a virtual pet that helps you learn, gives you quests and rewards you with coins.
1a1818fcbd5c44: You earn gold, silver and copper by completing quests (quizzes, chats and unlocking items). 100 copper = 1 silver, 100 silver = 1 gold. Spend them in the Shop.
1424d05cbe6359: Some items are functional: activate them from "Items" in My pet to unlock effects like themes, camera or this very book.
